items.title: Too many words
items.say: One. Too many words on screen. Keep it to three at a time.

items.title: Covering faces
items.say: Two. Covering faces. Put captions below the chin.

items.title: No highlight
items.say: Three. No highlight. Color the word being spoken.

caption: 3 caption mistakes killing your clips ✂️ Which one are you guilty of?
